dog.description_text: Meet Lucy! Lucy is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQBXcSoyXYe7R7WH1FSt5RLZAfmNKAiJd4j5ts7Or_oYhUU?e=M3DAoY Her foster says "Lucy made herself comfortable right away. She wanted to sniff everything of course but then immediately came to snuggle and get pets. This girl loves to purr and loves to cuddle. In terms of food, she prefers to graze over time and is a little bit picky on her food choice. It took her a few days as well to get used to routine, but now she’s having a great time. She loves one toy and it’s the cardboard cat dancer ". They love "Her vocalization and overall friendliness. She loves to chit chat and is always down for a snuggle. Lucy has been spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
